task: Fix only the four substantive Codex findings on PR #627 exact head 7d141ca33219813cadae0e4cfc39201b98564c0e, preserving the permanent Contabo staging launcher design and avoiding any infrastructure redesign. Finding 1 P1 discussion 3948299404: the NOPASSWD launcher currently authenticates the installed bootstrap but not the operation artifact, so a codex process with a repository-readable token could craft an artifact/local helper and get arbitrary root execution. Bind every privileged operation artifact to trusted-main GitHub workflow provenance that the unprivileged caller cannot choose or forge, and verify that provenance before any operation entrypoint executes. Use the existing control/release boundaries and GitHub APIs/metadata already available; do not introduce SSH or new long-lived secrets. Finding 2 P1 discussion 3948299409: the documented one-time root installer must not bless files from a mutable codex-owned checkout. Make installation consume independently authenticated exact reviewed source, e.g. root-controlled staging plus explicit exact-head/digest verification or another equivalently fail-closed mechanism; update the runbook so the owner has one deterministic install command/path that does not trust mutable runner bytes. Finding 3 P1 discussion 3948299414: launcher/off-host tests must fail closed predictably when the Contabo-only codex account is absent; catch/normalize the missing-account identity case or mock it appropriately so hosted CI gets the intended rejection rather than traceback. Finding 4 P2 discussion 3948299423: installer upgrades must be transactional; if final verification/self-test fails, restore the prior launcher, bootstrap and sudoers state rather than leaving a broken permanent interface. Add focused regression tests for all four findings and keep the existing tests. Do not deploy/provision, mutate sudoers/host state, access production, or weaken the digest/host/account/runner checks. Run focused CPython 3.14 tests, Ruff, shell/YAML safety checks and state resolver. Update PR branch only via the existing trusted push path. End with exact changed paths and test evidence.
